a.lede: Microsoft says a software bug introduced in July caused last week's worldwide Microsoft 365 outage, triggering a cascading failure that left more than 80% of its networking gateway servers unresponsive. [...]
a.title: Microsoft says months-old bug caused global Microsoft 365 outage

b.lede: Microsoft has said the outage was not caused by a cyber-security incident, but efforts to fix the issues have so far been largely unsuccessful.
b.title: What we know about the global Microsoft outage
